Developed T-SQL ETL processes using automated stored procedures to manage batch processing and ingest raw ERP and CRM data.
Engineered data cleansing, normalization, and enrichment workflows, designing business-ready Star Schema data models optimized for BI reporting.

projects.title: Marketing Analytics - Portfolio Project
bullets: Engineered end-to-end data pipelines by transforming messy e-commerce datasets using SQL Server into optimized relational reporting views.
Modeled complex text-based review sentiment using a Python VADER NLP model to convert unstructured customer feedback into measurable data metrics.
Built interactive Power BI dashboards tracking critical business KPIs, including Conversion Rate, Engagement, and Average Order Value.

projects.title: Sales Forecasting & Predictive Analytics
bullets: Cleaned and preprocessed a retail dataset of 8,500+ records by handling missing values, standardizing inconsistent categories, and deriving new metrics like store age.
Conducted Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) using Matplotlib and Seaborn, identifying sales distributions, pricing patterns (MRP), and key drivers across store types.
Built predictive regression models using Scikit-Learn to estimate product sales and uncover trends across outlet locations and item categories.

technical_stack: Advanced Excel (Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP, VBA, Power Query, Conditional Formatting)
